context-minimization-pattern.problem: User-supplied text lingers in context, enabling it to influence later generations and potentially inject malicious instructions
context-minimization-pattern.solution: Purge untrusted segments after transforming into safe intermediate. Later reasoning sees only trusted data
when: Multi-turn flows where input shouldn't steer later steps
cons: May hurt UX if too aggressive

context-window-anxiety-management.problem: Models exhibit 'context anxiety' near window limits, prematurely summarizing or rushing to complete tasks.
context-window-anxiety-management.solution: Provide buffer headroom and explicit reassurance that context is abundant to override anxiety behaviors.

dynamic-context-injection.problem: Agents often need specific context on-demand, but constantly editing static files or pasting text is inefficient.
dynamic-context-injection.solution: Use @mentions for files and /slash commands for reusable prompts to dynamically inject context during sessions.

filesystem-based-agent-state.problem: Long-running agent workflows lose all progress when interrupted, as state in context window does not persist across sessions.
filesystem-based-agent-state.solution: Persist intermediate results to files, creating durable checkpoints that enable workflow resumption and failure recovery.

layered-configuration-context.problem: Manually providing context in every prompt is cumbersome; global context is too broad or narrow.
layered-configuration-context.solution: Auto-discover and merge layered config files (enterprise, user, project, local) by filesystem hierarchy.

curated-code-context-window.problem: Dumping entire repositories into context overwhelms the model with noise and slows inference.
curated-code-context-window.solution: Use a search subagent to inject only top-K relevant code snippets into the main agent's context.
when: Need focused reasoning on specific modules

episodic-memory-retrieval-injection.problem: Stateless calls make agents forget prior decisions, causing repetition and shallow reasoning.
episodic-memory-retrieval-injection.solution: Add vector-backed episodic memory: store event/outcome/rationale blobs, retrieve top-k similar memories, inject as hints.

memory-synthesis-from-execution-logs.problem: Task logs contain valuable learnings but are too specific; hard to know which patterns generalize.
memory-synthesis-from-execution-logs.solution: Write structured task diaries, then periodically synthesize across logs to extract reusable patterns.

proactive-agent-state-externalization.problem: Models proactively write notes to preserve state, but self-generated summaries are often incomplete and may consume tokens better spent on task execution.
proactive-agent-state-externalization.solution: Provide structured templates and validation for agent self-documentation, combining agent notes with external memory systems as fallback.
cons: May consume tokens on documentation over progress

curated-file-context-window.problem: Loading all files into prompt exceeds token limits and introduces noise from unrelated code.
curated-file-context-window.solution: Load only primary files plus summarized secondary files from a search subagent's ranked results.
cons: May miss critical files if ranking is off

agent-powered-codebase-qa-onboarding.problem: Understanding large codebases is challenging; manual code tracing is time-consuming, especially during onboarding
agent-powered-codebase-qa-onboarding.solution: AI agent with retrieval/search/Q&A capabilities answers natural language queries about code structure and behavior

background-agent-ci.problem: Long-running tasks tie up the editor and require developers to babysit the agent throughout execution.
background-agent-ci.solution: Run agent asynchronously: push branch, wait for CI, ingest pass/fail output, iterate automatically, and notify when green.
when: Developer wants to work on other things
Mobile kick-offs (e.g., fix tests while away)
pros: Uses existing CI as feedback loop
cons: May iterate on wrong direction without oversight

dogfooding-with-rapid-iteration-for-agen.problem: External feedback loops are slow and simulated environments miss real-world nuances for agent improvement.
dogfooding-with-rapid-iteration-for-agen.solution: Development team uses their own AI agent daily, creating tight feedback loops for rapid iteration and honest assessment.

graph-of-thoughts.problem: Linear Chain-of-Thought reasoning cannot handle problems with complex interdependencies requiring paths that merge, split, and recombine.
graph-of-thoughts.solution: Represent reasoning as a directed graph where thoughts can branch, aggregate, refine, and loop back for iterative improvement.
when: Complex problems with interdependent reasoning steps
Tasks requiring insight aggregation from multiple paths
Problems needing iterative refinement and backtracking

reflection-loop.problem: Without self-review, LLM outputs may be low quality or fail to meet requirements
reflection-loop.solution: Generate → self-evaluate → incorporate feedback → regenerate until criteria met
cons: Infinite loop risk with vague metrics

spec-as-test-feedback-loop.problem: Implementations can drift from specs as code evolves, causing silent divergence
spec-as-test-feedback-loop.solution: Auto-generate executable tests from specs and run on every commit, with agent-authored PRs for fixes
pros: Keeps spec and impl in lock-step
cons: False positives with loose spec wording

tool-use-incentivization-via-reward-shap.problem: Agents underutilize tools (compilers, linters, tests) and default to internal thinking tokens instead of invoking external tools.
tool-use-incentivization-via-reward-shap.solution: Provide dense shaped rewards for each intermediate tool invocation (+1 compile, +2 test pass) to guide policy toward tool usage.

coding-agent-ci-feedback-loop.problem: Synchronous test runs block agent from parallel work, creating idle compute and inflated training times as agent babysits builds.
coding-agent-ci-feedback-loop.solution: Run agent async against CI: push branch, poll for partial failures, patch iteratively, notify on final green.
when: Long test suites that block iteration
pros: Compute efficiency - overlaps generation and testing
cons: Security - agent needs CI push/read permissions

inference-healed-code-review-reward.problem: Binary 'tests passed' rewards miss nuanced code quality issues like performance regressions, style violations, and security problems.
inference-healed-code-review-reward.solution: Use a multi-criteria code review critic that decomposes quality into subcriteria (correctness, style, perf, security) with explainable subscores.
when: When code quality beyond correctness matters
pros: Higher code quality via non-functional criteria
cons: Critic model maintenance as standards evolve

rich-feedback-loops.problem: Polishing a single prompt can't cover every edge case. Agents need ground truth to self-correct
rich-feedback-loops.solution: Expose iterative, machine-readable feedback (compiler errors, test failures, lint) after every tool call. Agent uses diagnostics to self-debug

self-critique-evaluator-loop.problem: Human preference labels are costly and quickly become outdated as base models improve, creating a bottleneck for reward model training.
self-critique-evaluator-loop.solution: Train a self-taught evaluator that bootstraps from synthetic data: generate candidates, judge with reasoning traces, fine-tune on its own judgments, and iterate.
when: Human labels too expensive to scale

self-discover-reasoning-structures.problem: Different reasoning tasks require different thinking strategies. Fixed reasoning patterns like Chain-of-Thought may be suboptimal for diverse problems.
self-discover-reasoning-structures.solution: Enable LLMs to automatically discover and compose task-specific reasoning structures by selecting and adapting atomic reasoning modules to match the problem's characteristics.

agent-reinforcement-fine-tuning.problem: Base models underperform on domain-specific tasks due to distribution shift and inefficient tool use.
agent-reinforcement-fine-tuning.solution: Train model end-to-end on agentic tasks with real tool calls, custom graders, and multi-step reinforcement.

ai-assisted-code-review-verification.problem: As AI generates more code, verification becomes the bottleneck. Need to ensure semantic correctness and intent alignment, not just syntax
ai-assisted-code-review-verification.solution: Use AI to analyze code changes, provide issues/summaries, and verify intent alignment through interactive Q&A
cons: Risk of overlooking errors due to over-trust

compounding-engineering-pattern.problem: Traditional engineering has diminishing returns; AI agents repeat mistakes because learnings aren't codified.
compounding-engineering-pattern.solution: Codify all learnings from each feature into prompts, commands, and hooks to make subsequent features easier.

reflection.problem: Generative models may produce subpar output if they never review or critique their own work
reflection.solution: After generating a draft, have the model grade it against a metric and refine using that feedback iteratively
when: Quality or adherence to criteria matters
Can iterate until threshold is met
cons: May stall if metric poorly defined

skill-library-evolution.problem: Agents solve similar problems across sessions but must rediscover solutions each time, wasting tokens
skill-library-evolution.solution: Persist working code as reusable functions in skills/ directory. Over time, evolve into documented, tested capabilities
when: Organization wants agents to build capability over time

variance-based-rl-sample-selection.problem: Zero-variance samples (always correct or always wrong) provide no learning signal, wasting compute in RL training.
variance-based-rl-sample-selection.solution: Run multiple baseline evals per sample, plot variance, prioritize high-variance samples where model sometimes succeeds.
when: Dataset may contain many solved/unsolvable samples
pros: Data efficiency - focus on learnable samples

sub-agent-spawning.problem: Large multi-file tasks overflow main agent's context window, exceeding reasoning budget
sub-agent-spawning.solution: Spawn independent sub-agents to work in parallel, then merge results

action-selector-pattern.problem: Untrusted input can hijack agent reasoning when tool feedback re-enters context window.
action-selector-pattern.solution: Use LLM only to map requests to pre-approved actions; no tool outputs fed back to the model.

autonomous-workflow-agent-architecture.problem: Complex engineering workflows require extensive human oversight, with manual coordination, monitoring, and intervention at each step.
autonomous-workflow-agent-architecture.solution: Containerized agents with tmux session management, intelligent monitoring, and context-aware error recovery for autonomous multi-step execution.
pros: Reduced human intervention for routine steps
cons: Limited handling of novel failure scenarios
Context window constraints for long workflows
Setup complexity for containers and monitoring

continuous-autonomous-task-loop-pattern.problem: Manual task orchestration—selection, commits, rate-limit handling—interrupts developer flow.
continuous-autonomous-task-loop-pattern.solution: Implement continuous loop with fresh context per task, auto-commits, and intelligent backoff.

distributed-execution-cloud-workers.problem: Single-session AI agent execution cannot scale to meet enterprise team demands with multiple simultaneous code changes.
distributed-execution-cloud-workers.solution: Run multiple Claude sessions in parallel using git worktrees and cloud workers with centralized coordination.

feature-list-as-immutable-contract.problem: Long-running agents declare premature victory, delete tests to pass, or lose track of requirements across sessions.
feature-list-as-immutable-contract.solution: Define all features upfront in an immutable JSON that agents can mark complete but cannot modify or delete.
when: Building complete applications with known requirements

iterative-multi-agent-brainstorming.problem: Single agent gets stuck in local optimum or fails to explore diverse solutions for complex problems.
iterative-multi-agent-brainstorming.solution: Spawn multiple agents with different perspectives to brainstorm in parallel, then synthesize best ideas.

multi-model-orchestration-for-complex-ed.problem: A single model may not be optimal for all sub-tasks in complex operations like multi-file code editing.
multi-model-orchestration-for-complex-ed.solution: Pipeline multiple specialized models: retrieval model for context, generation model for edits, and application model for changes.
when: Tasks with distinct retrieval, generation, and application phases
pros: More robust outcomes than single model

plan-then-execute-pattern.problem: If tool outputs alter choice of later actions, injected instructions may redirect agent toward malicious steps
plan-then-execute-pattern.solution: Split into Plan phase (fixed sequence before seeing untrusted data) and Execute phase (controller runs exact sequence)
when: Tasks where action set is known but params vary
cons: Output content can still be poisoned

self-rewriting-meta-prompt-loop.problem: Static system prompts become stale as agents encounter new tasks and edge cases
self-rewriting-meta-prompt-loop.solution: Let the agent rewrite its own system prompt after each interaction through reflection and validation
pros: No human in the loop for minor tweaks

three-stage-perception-architecture.problem: Monolithic agents mixing perception, reasoning, and action are hard to debug, extend, or scale independently.
three-stage-perception-architecture.solution: Separate workflow into three stages: Perception (input normalization), Processing (reasoning), and Action (execution).

agent-driven-research.problem: Traditional research lacks ability to adapt search strategies based on emerging results dynamically.
agent-driven-research.solution: Let agents independently formulate queries, execute searches, analyze results, and iterate until satisfied.

discrete-phase-separation.problem: Simultaneous research, planning, and implementation causes context contamination and degraded output.
discrete-phase-separation.solution: Break workflow into isolated phases (Research, Plan, Execute) with clean handoffs of distilled conclusions.
when: Mixing research and implementation hurts quality

dual-llm-pattern.problem: A privileged agent that sees untrusted text AND wields tools can be coerced into dangerous calls.
dual-llm-pattern.solution: Split into Privileged LLM (plans/tools, no raw data) and Quarantined LLM (reads data, no tools), passing data as symbolic variables.

inference-time-scaling.problem: Once trained, model performance is fixed. We cannot 'think harder' by allocating more compute for challenging problems.
inference-time-scaling.solution: Allocate additional inference compute dynamically: generate multiple candidates, perform extended reasoning, iterate and refine outputs.
when: Complex reasoning tasks where quality matters
When latency is acceptable for accuracy
pros: Dramatically improves performance on hard tasks

language-agent-tree-search-lats.problem: Linear reasoning (ReACT) gets stuck in local optima on complex tasks requiring strategic exploration.
language-agent-tree-search-lats.solution: Apply Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with LLM for action generation, evaluation, and backpropagation.

opponent-processor-multi-agent-debate.problem: Single-agent decisions suffer from confirmation bias, limited perspectives, and unexamined assumptions.
opponent-processor-multi-agent-debate.solution: Spawn opposing agents with different goals to debate each other, surfacing blind spots and unconsidered alternatives.

progressive-autonomy-with-model-evolutio.problem: Agent scaffolding built for older models becomes unnecessary overhead as models improve, creating prompt bloat, wasted tokens, and maintenance burden.
progressive-autonomy-with-model-evolutio.solution: Actively remove scaffolding as models become more capable. Regularly audit system prompts and orchestration logic to eliminate what newer models have internalized.
cons: May need different configs per model version

specification-driven-agent-development.problem: Hand-crafted prompts leave room for ambiguity; agents can over-interpret or conflict with stakeholder intent
specification-driven-agent-development.solution: Use a formal spec file as the agent's primary input and source of truth, iterating only by editing the spec
cons: Ramp-up for teams new to spec formats

tool-capability-compartmentalization.problem: Mix-and-match tools combining data readers, web fetchers, and writers amplify prompt-injection attack chains.
tool-capability-compartmentalization.solution: Split tools into reader/processor/writer micro-tools with isolated permissions and explicit per-call consent.

disposable-scaffolding-over-durable-feat.problem: Complex features built around models become obsolete when next-gen models perform those tasks natively.
disposable-scaffolding-over-durable-feat.solution: Treat tooling as temporary scaffolding; build simplest solutions expecting they will be discarded.
when: Need product agility over long-term investment
pros: Focus on unique value, not workarounds
cons: Tech debt accumulates if not cleaned

explicit-posterior-sampling-planner.problem: Agents relying on ad-hoc heuristics explore poorly, wasting tokens and API calls on dead ends.
explicit-posterior-sampling-planner.solution: Embed PSRL algorithm: maintain Bayesian posterior over task models, sample model, compute optimal plan, execute, update posterior.

initializer-maintainer-dual-agent.problem: Single-agent approaches either over-engineer each session (wasting setup time) or under-invest in foundations (causing drift and confusion).
initializer-maintainer-dual-agent.solution: Use two specialized agents: Initializer creates foundations once (features, env, tracking); Maintainer handles incremental development across sessions.
when: When context loss between sessions is costly
pros: Clear separation of setup vs execution

llm-map-reduce-pattern.problem: Single poisoned document can manipulate global reasoning if all data processed in one context.
llm-map-reduce-pattern.solution: Map: sandboxed LLMs process each doc independently. Reduce: aggregate only sanitized outputs.

oracle-and-worker-multi-model.problem: Single model creates trade-off between capability and cost. Powerful models are expensive for routine tasks.
oracle-and-worker-multi-model.solution: Two-tier system: fast Worker (Sonnet) handles bulk tasks, expensive Oracle (o3/Gemini) reserved for high-level reasoning and debugging.
when: Mix of routine and complex tasks
Tasks where worker may get stuck

progressive-complexity-escalation.problem: Deploying agents with overly ambitious capabilities from day one leads to unreliable outputs, failed implementations, and safety risks from autonomous high-stakes operations.
progressive-complexity-escalation.solution: Start with low-complexity, high-reliability tasks and progressively unlock more complex capabilities as models improve and trust is established through capability tiers.
pros: Risk mitigation via limited blast radius

stop-hook-auto-continue-pattern.problem: Agents complete turns even when tasks are not truly done (tests fail, checks incomplete)
stop-hook-auto-continue-pattern.solution: Use stop hooks to check success criteria after each turn; auto-continue agent until criteria pass

tree-of-thought-reasoning.problem: Linear chain-of-thought reasoning gets stuck on complex problems, missing alternatives or failing to backtrack.
tree-of-thought-reasoning.solution: Explore a search tree of intermediate thoughts, expand multiple steps, evaluate partial solutions before committing.

inversion-of-control.problem: Traditional 'prompt-as-puppeteer' workflows force humans to spell out every step, limiting scale and creativity.
inversion-of-control.solution: Give the agent tools plus a high-level goal and let it decide orchestration. Humans supply guard-rails (10%) while agent handles execution (87%).
when: Complex multi-step tasks with unclear sequence
Agent has necessary tools and capabilities
Human oversight available for critical decisions
pros: Scales to complex tasks without step-by-step prompting

parallel-tool-call-learning.problem: Agents execute tool calls sequentially even when they could run in parallel, causing unnecessary latency.
parallel-tool-call-learning.solution: Use Agent RFT to teach models to parallelize independent tool calls, reducing latency by 40-50% when tool execution is fast.

swarm-migration-pattern.problem: Large-scale code migrations (framework upgrades, lint fixes) are slow when done sequentially
swarm-migration-pattern.solution: Main agent orchestrates 10+ parallel subagents, each migrating a batch of files in map-reduce fashion
when: Lint rule rollouts across many files
cons: High token cost for parallel agents

parallel-tool-execution.problem: Sequential tool execution causes delays for read-only operations, but parallel execution risks race conditions for state-modifying tools.
parallel-tool-execution.solution: Classify tools as read-only or state-modifying. Execute read-only batches in parallel, serialize state-modifying operations.
when: Mix of read and write operations
Batch tool calls in single reasoning step
pros: Fast parallel reads, safe sequential writes
cons: Single write in batch serializes everything

anti-reward-hacking-grader-design.problem: RL models exploit grader loopholes to maximize reward without actually solving tasks, leading to 100% validation scores but poor real performance.
anti-reward-hacking-grader-design.solution: Design multi-criteria graders with iterative hardening, weighted subscores, and explicit gaming pattern detection.
when: Initial grader shows suspiciously high scores
Production performance doesn't match validation metrics
pros: Robust learning - models solve tasks, not game metrics
cons: Engineering effort for careful design and iteration
Slower convergence due to harder grading

cli-first-skill-design.problem: API-first is hard to debug, GUI-first is unusable by agents. Teams end up building two interfaces
cli-first-skill-design.solution: Design all skills as CLI tools first. Humans use terminal, agents use Bash tool - same interface
when: Building skills for both humans and agents
Want to compose with Unix pipes

criticgpt-style-evaluation.problem: Human reviewers struggle to catch subtle bugs in sophisticated AI-generated code at scale.
criticgpt-style-evaluation.solution: Deploy specialized critic models trained for code review to identify bugs, security issues, and quality problems.

extended-coherence-work-sessions.problem: Early AI agents lose coherence after a few minutes, limiting their utility for complex multi-stage tasks requiring sustained effort.
extended-coherence-work-sessions.solution: Use models and architectures designed to maintain coherence over hours through larger context windows and better state management.
when: Tasks requiring sustained context across stages

lethal-trifecta-threat-model.problem: Combining private data + untrusted input + external communication enables prompt injection data exfiltration.
lethal-trifecta-threat-model.solution: Audit every tool for these 3 capabilities and guarantee at least one is blocked in any execution path.

merged-code-language-skill-model.problem: Training a single model for both code and natural language requires massive compute and risks skill interference.
merged-code-language-skill-model.solution: Train separate specialist models independently, then merge weights to combine skills without centralized training.
when: Parallel R&D teams for different capabilities

rlaif-reinforcement-learning-from-ai-fee.problem: Traditional RLHF requires extensive human annotation for preference data, which is expensive ($1+ per annotation), time-consuming, and creates a bottleneck in training aligned AI systems.
rlaif-reinforcement-learning-from-ai-fee.solution: Use AI models to generate preference feedback and evaluation data based on constitutional principles, reducing costs to less than $0.01 per annotation while maintaining quality.

structured-output-specification.problem: Free-form agent outputs are hard to validate, parse, and integrate with downstream systems
structured-output-specification.solution: Constrain outputs using deterministic schemas (JSON Schema, Zod, Pydantic) enforced at generation time

versioned-constitution-governance.problem: Self-modifying agents can accidentally violate safety rules or regress on alignment when rewriting their constitution.
versioned-constitution-governance.solution: Store constitution in version-controlled, signed repo with CI policy checks; agent proposes, gatekeeper merges.
when: Agent can modify its own rules

asynchronous-coding-agent-pipeline.problem: Synchronous tool execution (compilation, testing) creates compute bubbles and idle GPUs, blocking agents while waiting for I/O-bound operations.
asynchronous-coding-agent-pipeline.solution: Decouple inference, tool execution, and learning into parallel async components communicating via message queues.
when: Running RL training for coding agents
Tool calls have high latency (compilation, tests)
pros: High utilization - GPUs stay busy during I/O
Scalable - independently scale inference, tools, learning

no-token-limit-magic.problem: Aggressive prompt compression to save tokens stifles reasoning depth and self-correction capabilities.
no-token-limit-magic.solution: During prototyping, remove hard token limits. Allow lavish context and multiple reasoning passes to discover valuable patterns.
cons: Not suitable for production without optimization

deterministic-security-scanning-build-lo.problem: Non-deterministic security approaches (cursor rules, MCP tools) are suggestions that LLMs may ignore.
deterministic-security-scanning-build-lo.solution: Integrate deterministic security scanners into the build loop that agents must run after every change.
cons: Requires fast tools for good DX

egress-lockdown-no-exfiltration-channel.problem: Even with private-data access and untrusted inputs, attacks fail if the agent has no way to transmit stolen data.
egress-lockdown-no-exfiltration-channel.solution: Implement egress firewall: allow only specific domains, strip content from outbound calls, forbid dynamic link generation.

isolated-vm-per-rl-rollout.problem: RL training rollouts share infrastructure, causing cross-contamination and corrupted rewards when agents execute destructive commands.
isolated-vm-per-rl-rollout.solution: Spin up an isolated VM/container for each rollout, ensuring complete environment isolation with fresh state.

pii-tokenization.problem: Sending raw PII through the model's context creates privacy risks and compliance concerns.
pii-tokenization.solution: Intercept tool responses to tokenize PII before reaching model, untokenize when making actual tool calls.
pros: Prevents raw PII in model context

agent-first-tooling-and-logging.problem: Human-centric tools with colored, multi-line outputs are hard for agents to parse reliably.
agent-first-tooling-and-logging.solution: Design tools with machine-readable outputs (JSON), unified logs, and --for-agent flags for agent consumption.

cli-native-agent-orchestration.problem: Web chat UIs are awkward for repeat runs, local file edits, or scripting inside CI pipelines.
cli-native-agent-orchestration.solution: Expose agent capabilities through a first-class CLI for Makefiles, Git hooks, cron jobs, and headless automation.
when: Need headless or scripted agent execution
pros: Scriptable and composable with other tools
Easy to embed in existing workflows

code-then-execute-pattern.problem: Plan lists are opaque; need full data-flow analysis and taint tracking for security
code-then-execute-pattern.solution: LLM outputs sandboxed program/DSL. Static checker verifies flows, interpreter runs in locked sandbox

dual-use-tool-design.problem: Building separate tools for humans and AI agents creates maintenance overhead, inconsistent behavior, and feature drift.
dual-use-tool-design.solution: Design all tools to be dual-use: same interface, shared logic, equally accessible to both humans and AI agents.

llm-friendly-api-design.problem: APIs designed for humans are often ambiguous or complex for LLMs, causing unreliable tool use.
llm-friendly-api-design.solution: Design APIs with explicit versioning, self-descriptive names, clear errors, and minimal indirection.

multi-platform-communication-aggregation.problem: Searching for info across multiple platforms (email, Slack, iMessage) requires slow manual checks on each
multi-platform-communication-aggregation.solution: Create unified search interface that queries all platforms in parallel and aggregates results into single format

patch-steering-via-prompted-tool-selecti.problem: Agents with multiple patching tools may choose suboptimal ones, causing inconsistent and lower quality results.
patch-steering-via-prompted-tool-selecti.solution: Steer tool selection through explicit natural language instructions, specifying preferred tools and usage patterns in prompts.
when: AST-safe operations preferred over text replace
pros: Higher code quality with semantic tools

proactive-trigger-vocabulary.problem: Agents with many skills face opaque routing - users don't know which phrases activate which capabilities
proactive-trigger-vocabulary.solution: Define explicit trigger vocabulary (keywords, patterns) per skill, documented visibly for transparent and predictable skill routing
when: Need clear activation paths for users
Want proactive activation on certain topics
cons: Misses paraphrases not in trigger list

shell-command-contextualization.problem: Manually copying shell command output into agent context is tedious and error-prone
shell-command-contextualization.solution: Provide a special prefix (e.g., !) that executes shell commands and auto-injects both command and output into agent context
when: Checking git status, file listings, test results

tool-use-steering-via-prompting.problem: Having tools available does not guarantee agents will use them appropriately, especially for custom or team-specific tools.
tool-use-steering-via-prompting.solution: Guide tool selection via explicit prompts: direct invocation, teaching tool usage, implicit shortcuts, and deeper reasoning triggers.

agent-sdk-for-programmatic-control.problem: Interactive interfaces don't support CI/CD pipelines, scheduled jobs, or custom application integration.
agent-sdk-for-programmatic-control.solution: Provide SDK (CLI, Python, TypeScript) exposing agent actions for programmatic access and automation.

code-first-tool-interface-pattern.problem: Traditional MCP tool calls force all intermediate JSON through the context, causing massive token waste on multi-step and fan-out operations.
code-first-tool-interface-pattern.solution: LLMs write TypeScript code that orchestrates MCP tools in V8 isolates; only final results return to context.
when: Token costs or latency are critical
pros: Self-debugging with error handling and retry
cons: Poor fit for dynamic research loops

dynamic-code-injection-on-demand-file-fe.problem: Manually copying files into prompts is tedious, wastes tokens, and interrupts workflow momentum.
dynamic-code-injection-on-demand-file-fe.solution: Allow on-demand file injection via @filename or /load syntax that fetches, optionally summarizes, and injects code into context.

progressive-tool-discovery.problem: Loading all tool definitions upfront consumes excessive context window space when agents have access to large tool catalogs, limiting space for actual task execution.
progressive-tool-discovery.solution: Present tools through a filesystem-like hierarchy where agents discover capabilities on-demand, requesting different detail levels (name only, description, full schema) as needed.

subagent-compilation-checker.problem: Including full build logs in main agent context blows up context length and slows inference
subagent-compilation-checker.solution: Spawn specialized subagents to compile each module, returning only concise error summaries to main agent
when: Build logs too verbose for context

virtual-machine-operator-agent.problem: Agents limited to code generation cannot perform complex tasks requiring full computer environment interaction.
virtual-machine-operator-agent.solution: Give agent access to a dedicated VM environment to execute code, install packages, manage files, and run applications.
when: Need to install and run software

agentic-search-over-vector-embeddings.problem: Vector embeddings require continuous re-indexing, handling local changes, and infrastructure overhead.
agentic-search-over-vector-embeddings.solution: Replace vector search with agentic search using bash, grep, and file traversal - no pre-indexing needed.

code-over-api-pattern.problem: Direct API calls force all intermediate data through the model's context window, causing 150K+ tokens for data-heavy workflows.
code-over-api-pattern.solution: Agent writes code that executes in sandbox; data processing happens in execution environment with only results returning to context.
when: Cost-sensitive applications where token usage matters
pros: Natural fit for data processing tasks
cons: Debugging errors happens in execution, not context

visual-ai-multimodal-integration.problem: Text-only agents miss critical visual information in images, videos, diagrams, and UI screenshots.
visual-ai-multimodal-integration.solution: Integrate multimodal models (LMMs) to accept visual inputs, extract information, and combine with text for cross-modal reasoning.

abstracted-code-representation-for-revie.problem: Reviewing large AI-generated code line-by-line is tedious and error-prone when humans mainly care about intent and logic.
abstracted-code-representation-for-revie.solution: Provide abstracted representations (pseudocode, intent summaries) with guarantees they map to actual code changes.

ai-accelerated-learning-and-skill-develo.problem: Developing code 'taste' and skills requires extensive experience and mentorship, a slow process especially for juniors
ai-accelerated-learning-and-skill-develo.solution: Use AI agents as interactive learning tools enabling fast iteration, mistake learning, and best practice observation
cons: Learning quality depends on AI output

chain-of-thought-monitoring-interruption.problem: Agents can pursue misguided reasoning paths for extended periods. By the time developers realize it's wrong, significant time and tokens are wasted.
chain-of-thought-monitoring-interruption.solution: Real-time surveillance of agent reasoning with low-friction interrupt capability to redirect before completing flawed sequences.
when: Complex refactoring where wrong file choices are costly
pros: Prevents wasted time on fundamentally wrong approaches
Maximizes value from expensive model calls
cons: Can interrupt productive exploration if triggered prematurely
Adds cognitive load to monitor reasoning

democratization-of-tooling-via-agents.problem: Non-engineering roles (sales, marketing, ops) need custom tools but lack programming skills to build them
democratization-of-tooling-via-agents.solution: AI agent translates natural language requests into code, enabling domain experts to create their own tools
when: Quick bug fixes to existing code

human-in-loop.problem: Auto-executing dangerous operations (DB delete, deploy) causes safety/compliance issues. Blocking all defeats automation
human-in-loop.solution: Insert human approval gate only for high-risk ops. Safe ops auto-execute, risky ones require Slack approval

human-in-loop-approval-framework.problem: Autonomous agents need to execute high-risk operations (DB changes, deployments), but unsupervised execution creates unacceptable safety risks.
human-in-loop-approval-framework.solution: Insert human approval gates for high-risk functions via Slack/email/SMS, maintaining agent autonomy for safe operations.
when: External API calls with side effects (payments)
pros: Safe autonomous execution of risky ops

latent-demand-product-discovery.problem: Difficult to predict which features have real product-market fit before significant engineering investment.
latent-demand-product-discovery.solution: Build hackable products, observe how power users repurpose features, then productize validated demand.

spectrum-of-control-blended-initiative.problem: One-size-fits-all agent autonomy doesn't fit varying task complexity or user familiarity
spectrum-of-control-blended-initiative.solution: Provide a spectrum of control modes from low (tab-complete) to high (background agent) that users can switch between
when: Varying task complexity within one session

team-shared-agent-configuration.problem: Independent agent configs per developer cause inconsistent behavior, permission friction, and duplicated effort across the team.
team-shared-agent-configuration.solution: Store agent configuration in version control as code, enabling team-wide sharing via git pull.
when: Multiple team members use AI agents

agent-assisted-scaffolding.problem: Starting new features involves writing repetitive boilerplate and foundational code, which is time-consuming.
agent-assisted-scaffolding.solution: Use AI to generate initial structure, files, and boilerplate from high-level descriptions, then focus on core logic.

seamless-background-to-foreground-handof.problem: Background agents can handle complex tasks autonomously but may achieve only 90% correctness. A clunky handoff process to human control negates the automation benefits.
seamless-background-to-foreground-handof.solution: Design systems allowing seamless transition from background agent work to foreground human control, preserving context so users can refine the remaining 10% efficiently.
when: Tasks requiring human finesse for completion
Developer workflows with autonomous PR generation
pros: Retains human control for final touches

verbose-reasoning-transparency.problem: Complex agents behave like black boxes; users cannot understand why decisions were made or debug unexpected behavior.
verbose-reasoning-transparency.solution: Provide on-demand verbose mode (e.g., Ctrl+R) showing reasoning steps, tool selection rationale, and raw outputs.

agent-friendly-workflow-design.problem: Agents struggle when workflows are too rigid or humans micromanage technical decisions.
agent-friendly-workflow-design.solution: Design workflows with clear goals, appropriate autonomy, structured I/O, and iterative feedback loops.
